policy.discrete_prediction_curve: linear in log10 pressure, positive endpoints only, no extrapolation
policy.evidence: Preserve E0-E5; E5 permitted with approximate predictor mappings flagged.
policy.ksat: Atomic only; m/s, log10 scoring; nonpositive predictions explicitly invalid.
policy.meaningful_ensemble_improvement: At least 1% pooled RMSE reduction and lower RMSE in every held-out group; descriptive, not a population significance claim.
policy.primary_cohort: Largest roster covering at least half the maximum executable sample coverage; ties by sample count then point count.
policy.reduced_ensemble: Best training atomic plus best member among top five training models with residual correlation below 0.95; otherwise two best. Equal weights. Re-select inside every outer fold.
policy.robustness: Leave one source out; otherwise profile; otherwise 500 sample bootstrap draws, seed 20261026.
policy.water_basis: Separate original volume and mass cohorts; no harmonization.
